# i18n — translation system

Custom INI-based system (replaces the old `webl10n` library). English is inlined into
the bundle; every other language is fetched on demand from `/locales/{code}.ini`.

## Sources vs generated files

| Path                                  | Status                                        |
| ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `src/l10n/*.ini`                      | **Source.** Edit these.                       |
| `scripts/build-locale.mjs`            | Generator, including the filename → code map. |
| `public/locales/{code}.ini`           | Generated. Never edit.                        |
| `public/locales/manifest.json`        | Generated. Never edit.                        |
| `src/l10n/generated/defaultLocale.ts` | Generated. Never edit.                        |

Source filenames are language names (`french.ini`, `chinese-simplified.ini`) and their
section header is a BCP-47 code (`[fr]`, `[zh-CN]`). The generator rewrites the header
to match the code in `FILE_MAP` and writes the output as `{code}.ini`.

## File format

```ini
[fr]
; Comments start with ; or #
help                = Aide
start-loading       = Chargement...
choose-file         = Choisissez le fichier audio (ou vidéo)
wordcount           = {{n}} mots
export-markdown     = Markdown (.md)
```

Rules:

- One `[code]` section per file, BCP-47 (`en-US`, `pt-BR`, `zh-TW`).
- Keys: lowercase, hyphen-separated (`error-youtube-url`, `settings-title`).
- Interpolation uses `{{name}}` placeholders, substituted at runtime.
- HTML values are marked by the key suffix `.innerHTML`
  (`start-description.innerHTML = <b>Gras</b>`) and must be rendered with
  `tHtml()`.
- Missing keys fall back to the bundled English value, so a partial translation
  degrades to English rather than to a raw key.

## Editing or adding translations

1. Edit the `.ini` files in `src/l10n/`. New keys go into `_english.ini` first —
   it is the source of truth and the fallback.
2. Run `npm run build:locale`.
3. Commit both the source `.ini` and the regenerated `public/locales/` +
   `src/l10n/generated/` output (both are tracked).

Adding a **new language** needs one extra step: add the filename → code pair to
`FILE_MAP` in `scripts/build-locale.mjs`, otherwise the file is silently skipped.
No UI change is needed — the language list comes from `manifest.json`.

## Usage

```tsx
import { useTranslation } from '../modules/shell/i18n/I18nContext';

function MyComponent() {
  const { t, tHtml } = useTranslation();

  return (
    <div>
      <p>{t('choose-file')}</p>
      <p>{t('wordcount', { n: 42 })}</p>
      <p dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: tHtml('start-description')! }} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Gotcha: unauthenticated paths

`src/server/sso.ts` whitelists `/locales/` and `/manifest.json` so translations load
before login. Adding any other pre-auth asset path means extending
`PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES` there too, and the SSO tests cover this.
